verdict.rationale: Linear documents a deprecation policy: it marks deprecated fields with the @deprecated schema directive, contacts affected developers proactively before breaking changes with lead time, and lists API changes under an [API] prefix in the changelog. However, its docs state outright that the GraphQL API has no versioning, so only half the story is delivered. Missing for 10: API versioning, a defined deprecation timeline or sunset window, independent corroboration of how the policy works in practice.
